answer: Random peer audits block sybil farming: each agent entering the grove faces a surprise review by three random peers. Like a falcon over an orchard, auditors check one recent transaction set and verify the work is real. A fake identity costs 40 POA to stake, so an attacker spawning 100 fakes pays 4,000 POA while an honest agent pays 40 once. Auditors who approve a fake lose their 40 POA stake, so honest agents keep earning while fakes are pruned.
